author: Mark Atwood
text:
Survey complete.

Cross-references verified clean (no drift):
- urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat / chat:push capability URNs match main draft
- Body-type vocabulary (text/plain, text/markdown, application/jmap-chat-rich, application/mls-ciphertext, application/mimi-content) consistent; push draft plaintext enumeration + default-deny escape hatch correctly handles application/mimi-content edge case
- mention_all permission still defined in main draft :582
- ChatContact.id / displayName / login field names exist and match (main draft :327, :330)
- Chat.muted / muteUntil exclusion case matches main draft :445
- StateChange fallback semantics consistent with RFC 8620 PushSubscription
- Authorization model: push draft delivery MUSTs are wire-level (not Space-permission gated), so 38055ec per-method latitude does not affect them
- 'account owner' usage in push draft is mailbox-owner sense throughout (not group-chat governance); no c93e545 drift

Findings filed:
- ex4u (P2 bug): hasMention computation wrong for application/jmap-chat-rich messages — main draft :1257 mandates Message.mentions empty for rich-body with mention info inline in spans. Filed independent of fig9.4 because fig9.4 is about scope (broadcast vs per-user), not about location (array vs spans).
- 0yka (P3 task): senderDisplayName fallback chain omits SpaceMember.nick for channel chats; editorially inconsistent with main draft :599-600 SpaceMember.nick semantics.

Items deferred to fig9.4 (not duplicated):
- hasMention / hasMentionAll field semantics overall
- mentionUrgency mapping
- Payload examples involving broadcast mention scopes

Items considered and rejected as findings:
- 'properties' default vs supported minimum (line 119) omits chatName/spaceId/spaceName: design choice, not drift
- Body-type enumeration vs supportedBodyTypes extensibility: escape hatch covers it, no break
- 'sender is account owner' phrasing vs main draft senderId=='self': equivalent semantics, prose acceptable

bd remembered the mention-storage-in-two-places tension.
